description: A utility module for extracting trusted user information from FastAPI request objects. It provides a function to retrieve user ID and user data from request headers, query parameters, or JSON-encoded strings, prioritizing header values.

methods.name: get_trusted_user(request: Request)
methods.description: Extracts a trusted user ID and user data from the incoming FastAPI request, checking headers first, then query parameters, and attempting to parse JSON data if present.
